brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.

requirements.evidence: Single-cell enclosure: piece:0,0,0;full with top cover cover:0,0,0;full;top and all six side faces capped (caps at 30/90/150/210/270/330) forming fully closed volume, meshClash clear, joints locked

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre port:0#0,0#0 in slot 0 of the cell, described as venting a closed cell without letting rain in

finish.summary: Built single-cell closed enclosure: full hex base with top cover and all side caps sealed, plus hex-port-louvre vent for airflow. House rules lockJoints applied, enclosure verified clear.
